evals.name: research-topic-context
evals.prompt: I need to research how eBPF works in Android for a paper I'm writing. Can you find everything in my notes about eBPF and Android and build me a context summary?
evals.expected_output: Uses pkms resolve or query to find eBPF and Android notes, retrieves context with depth, produces a structured summary

evals.name: fix-broken-links
evals.prompt: My org-roam database has a bunch of broken links pointing to an old LTE note UUID ca233557. Can you figure out what the correct LTE note UUID is now and fix all those broken links?
evals.expected_output: Uses resolve to find current LTE UUID, uses fix to replace broken UUID, reports files changed

evals.name: find-and-link-orphans
evals.prompt: Show me all the orphan notes in my PKMS database, then for 'fuzz testing' suggest which notes it should link to and actually link it.
evals.expected_output: Uses orphans to list orphans, uses suggest to find related notes for fuzz testing, appends a link
